Kural Heart

The official F-Droid repository for Kural Heart, a private Android journal with Thiruvalluvar: one Thirukkural couplet a day, a question it asks of you, and a page that stays on your phone. Same signed APKs as the GitHub releases.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://inigo-code.github.io/kural-heart-site/fdroid/repo
